en.t: Jovian is proclaimed Roman emperor following the death of emperor Julian in the previous night
en.s: Jovian (; Latin: Jovianus; Greek: Ἰοβιανός Iobianós; 331 – 17 February 364) was Roman emperor from June 363 to February 364. As part of the imperial bodyguard, he accompanied Julian on his Persian expedition. Julian was killed in battle, and the exhausted and ill-provisioned Roman army declared Jovian his successor. Unable to cross the Tigris, Jovian made peace with the Sasanian Empire on humiliating terms.

zh.t: 尤利安前一夜去世后，朱维安被推举为罗马皇帝
zh.s: 公元363年6月27日，尤利安皇帝前一夜阵亡后，疲惫且补给不足的罗马军队推举随他远征波斯的卫队成员朱维安为继任者。朱维安（拉丁语：Jovianus；希腊语：Ἰοβιανός）在位至364年2月，因无法渡过底格里斯河而与萨珊帝国达成条件屈辱的和约。

en.t: Pope Agatho is consecrated following the death of pope Donus two months prior
en.s: Pope Agatho (c. 577 – 10 January 681) served as the bishop of Rome from 27 June 678 until his death on 10 January 681. He heard the appeal of Wilfrid of York, who had been displaced from his see by the division of the archdiocese ordered by Theodore of Canterbury. During Agatho's tenure, the Sixth Ecumenical Council was convened to deal with monothelitism.

zh.t: 阿加托在前任教宗去世两个月后祝圣为教宗
zh.s: 教宗阿加托（约577年—681年1月10日）于678年6月27日至681年1月10日担任罗马主教。他受理了约克的威尔弗里德提出的申诉；坎特伯雷的西奥多曾下令划分总教区，导致威尔弗里德失去教区。在阿加托任内，第六次大公会议召开，处理一性意志论争议。

en.s: The siege of Novo Brdo was a military blockade of Novo Brdo, an important fortified mining town in the Serbian Despotate, by the forces of the Ottoman Empire. The siege began in 1440 and lasted until the capture of the fortress on 27 June 1441. During the siege, the Serbian garrison was supported by the local community of citizens of the Republic of Ragusa.

zh.s: 奥斯曼帝国军队围困塞尔维亚专制国的重要设防矿业城镇诺沃布尔多。围城始于1440年，直到1441年6月27日奥斯曼军攻占要塞才结束。围城期间，塞尔维亚守军得到当地拉古萨共和国居民的支持。

en.s: The Fourth Ottoman–Venetian War, also known as the War of Cyprus, was fought between 1570 and 1573. It was waged between the Ottoman Empire (with the Barbary States)and the Republic of Venice, the latter joined by the Holy League, a coalition of Christian states formed by the pope which included Spain (with Naples and Sicily), the Republic of Genoa, the Duchy of Savoy, the Knights Hospitaller, and the Grand Duchy of Tuscany.

zh.t: 第四次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争
zh.s: 1570年至1573年，奥斯曼帝国（及巴巴里诸国）与威尼斯共和国交战，史称第四次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争或塞浦路斯战争。威尼斯方面后来加入了教宗组织的神圣同盟，其中包括西班牙（连同那不勒斯和西西里）、热那亚共和国、萨伏依公国、医院骑士团和托斯卡纳大公国。

en.s: The Battle of Mogilev took place on 27 June 1581 during the Livonian campaign of Stephen Báthory. It was fought between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth led by Marcin Kazanowski and Krzysztof Radziwiłł against the Tsardom of Russia and Tatars led by Ivan the Terrible. After 7 hours of fighting on an open field, it resulted in a Polish–Lithuanian victory.

zh.s: 莫吉廖夫战役于1581年6月27日爆发，是斯特凡·巴托里利沃尼亚战役的一部分。马尔钦·卡扎诺夫斯基和克日什托夫·拉齐维乌率领的波兰—立陶宛联邦军队与伊凡雷帝统率的俄罗斯沙皇国和鞑靼军队交战。双方在开阔地战斗7小时后，波兰—立陶宛一方获胜。

en.s: The Landing at Ystad (Danish: Landgangen ved Ysted, Swedish: Landningen vid Ystad), also known as the Battle of Ystad, (Danish: Slaget ved Ysted, Swedish: Slaget vid Ystad) was an amphibious attack and landing at Ystad performed by a Dano-Dutch fleet on 27 June 1676 during the Scanian War. The landing was a success, and the Swedish garrison and relief force were forced to retreat.

zh.s: 伊斯塔德登陆战又称伊斯塔德战役。1676年6月27日，丹麦—荷兰舰队在斯科讷战争期间对伊斯塔德发动两栖攻击并登陆。行动成功，瑞典守军和增援部队被迫撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Vác was fought on June 27, 1684, near the city of Vác in central Hungary, between the forces of the Ottoman Empire, and the forces of the Holy Roman Empire as part of the Great Turkish War. The Austrian army was victorious.

zh.s: 1684年6月27日，奥斯曼帝国军队与神圣罗马帝国军队在匈牙利中部瓦茨城附近交战，属于大土耳其战争。奥地利军队获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Norton St Philip was fought on 27 June 1685, during the Monmouth Rebellion in the village of Norton St Philip, in Somerset, England. The battle was the last victory for the rebel forces.

zh.s: 诺顿圣菲利普战役于1685年6月27日在英格兰萨默塞特郡诺顿圣菲利普村爆发，是蒙茅斯叛乱的一部分。这是叛军取得的最后一次胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Lagos was fought during the Nine Years' War on 27 June 1693 (17 June 1693 O.S.), when a French fleet under Anne Hilarion de Tourville defeated an Anglo-Dutch fleet under George Rooke near Lagos Bay in Portugal. Rooke's squadron was protecting the Smyrna convoy, and it is by this name that the action is sometimes known.

zh.s: 1693年6月27日（儒略历6月17日），九年战争期间，安妮·伊拉里翁·德·图维尔率领的法国舰队在葡萄牙拉各斯湾附近击败乔治·鲁克率领的英荷舰队。鲁克的分舰队当时正在护送士麦那商船队，因此这场战斗有时也以商船队命名。

en.t: Rival factions elect competing kings of Poland–Lithuania
en.s: On June 27, 1697, rival factions at Wola near Warsaw chose François Louis, Prince of Conti, and Frederick Augustus of Saxony as competing kings of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.

zh.t: 波兰立陶宛国王选举出现两名竞争者
zh.s: 1697年6月27日，波兰立陶宛联邦的国王选举在华沙附近的沃拉举行。两个阵营分别拥立孔蒂亲王弗朗索瓦·路易和萨克森的腓特烈·奥古斯特。

en.s: The Battle of Stekene took place on 27 June 1703, during the War of the Spanish Succession, when a Dutch force of 7,000 men, under Karel Willem Sparre, attacked the Franco-Spanish defensive that ran from Ostend to Antwerp. The lines at Stekene were defended by 2,500 French soldiers under La Mothe and 1,500 to 6,000 local Flemish farmers.

zh.s: 1703年6月27日，西班牙王位继承战争期间，卡雷尔·威廉·斯帕雷率领的7,000名荷兰军队进攻一条从奥斯坦德延伸至安特卫普的法西防线。斯特克内一带由拉莫特率领的2,500名法国士兵和1,500至6,000名当地佛兰德农民防守。

en.s: The Battle of Dettingen (German: Schlacht bei Dettingen) took place on 27 June 1743 at Dettingen on the River Main, Germany, during the War of the Austrian Succession. The British forces, in alliance with those of Hanover and Hesse, defeated a French army under the duc de Noailles. George II commanded his troops in the battle, and this marked the last time a British monarch personally led his troops on the field. The battle straddled the river about 18 miles east of Frankfurt, with guns on the Hessian bank but most of the combat on the flat Bavarian bank.

zh.s: 德廷根战役于1743年6月27日在德国美因河畔的德廷根爆发，属于奥地利王位继承战争。英国与汉诺威和黑森结盟，击败诺阿耶公爵率领的法军。乔治二世亲自指挥英军，这是英国君主最后一次亲临战场指挥军队。战场横跨河流，位于法兰克福以东约18英里；黑森一侧部署了火炮，大部分交战则发生在平坦的巴伐利亚河岸。

en.s: The Battle of Echoee, or Etchoe Pass, was a battle on June 27, 1760 during the French and Indian War, between the British and colonial force under Archibald Montgomerie and a force of Cherokee warriors under Seroweh. It took place near the present-day municipality of Otto, in Macon County, North Carolina.

zh.s: 埃乔伊战役又称埃乔伊山口战役，于1760年6月27日在法国和印第安人战争期间爆发。阿奇博尔德·蒙哥马利率领的英国及殖民地军队与塞罗韦率领的切罗基战士交战。战场位于如今北卡罗来纳州梅肯县奥托附近。

en.s: The action of 27 June 1798 was a single-ship action fought between the British and French navies in the Strait of Sicily as part of the Mediterranean campaign of 1798. On 19 May 1798, a French fleet left Toulon to invade Egypt. On 12 June the French fleet captured Malta, after which the 32-gun frigate Sensible, captained by Frigate Captain Guillaume-François-Joseph Bourdé, was detached from the fleet to transport wounded troops and loot back to France.

zh.s: 1798年6月27日，英法军舰在西西里海峡单独交战，属于1798年地中海战役的一部分。5月19日，法国舰队从土伦出发入侵埃及；6月12日攻占马耳他后，舰队派出由纪尧姆-弗朗索瓦-约瑟夫·布尔代指挥的32炮护卫舰“Sensible”号，运送伤兵和战利品返回法国。

en.s: The Battle of Neuburg occurred on 27 June 1800 in the south German state of Bavaria, on the southern bank of the Danube river. Neuburg is located on the Danube between Ingolstadt and Donauwörth. This battle occurred late in the War of the Second Coalition (1798–1802), the second war between Revolutionary France and the conservative European monarchies, which included at one time or another Britain, Habsburg Austria, Russia (until late 1799), the Ottoman Empire (Turkey), Portugal and Naples.

zh.s: 新堡战役于1800年6月27日在德国南部巴伐利亚州爆发，战场位于多瑙河南岸。新堡位于多瑙河畔、因戈尔施塔特和多瑙沃特之间。此役发生在第二次反法同盟战争（1798—1802）后期。这是革命法国与欧洲保守君主国之间的第二次战争，英国、哈布斯堡奥地利、俄罗斯（至1799年末）、奥斯曼帝国、葡萄牙和那不勒斯等国曾先后参战。

en.s: The siege of the Salamanca forts (17–27 June 1812) saw an 800-man Imperial French garrison directed by Lieutenant Colonel Duchemin defend three fortified convents in the city of Salamanca against the 48,000-strong Allied army led by Arthur Wellesley, Lord Wellington. During this time, the French commander Marshal Auguste de Marmont led a 40,000-man French army in an unsuccessful attempt to relieve the garrison.

zh.s: 萨拉曼卡要塞围城战发生于1812年6月17日至27日。杜舍曼中校率领的800名法兰西帝国守军在萨拉曼卡市内防守三座设防修道院，对抗阿瑟·韦尔斯利（威灵顿公爵）领导的48,000名联军。与此同时，法国指挥官奥古斯特·德·马尔蒙元帅率领40,000名法军试图解围，但未能成功。

en.s: Pawnee leader Blue Coat's village near the Loup River in Nebraska at a site called Plum Creek was attacked by a group of Lakota fighters on June 27, 1843. This was the worst blow to the Pawnee people until the attack in Massacre Canyon by the Lakota in 1873. Between 65 and 70 Pawnees were killed, scalped and mutilated, half of the earth lodges were burnt.

zh.s: 1843年6月27日，拉科塔战士袭击了波尼族首领“蓝外套”位于今内布拉斯加州洛普河附近普拉姆溪的村庄。这是1873年屠杀峡袭击发生前，波尼族遭受的最沉重打击。65至70名波尼族人被杀害、剥头皮并肢解，半数土屋被烧毁。

en.s: The Battle of Ihász took place during the Summer Campaign of the Hungarian War of Independence. It was fought on 27 June 1849 around and in Ihász, a formerly existing village, today part of Marcaltő. In this battle, the Hungarian division led by General György Kmety fought against the Austrian Gerstner brigade led by Lieutenant General Adolf Schütte Edler von Warensberg.

zh.s: 伊哈斯战役发生于匈牙利独立战争夏季战役期间，于1849年6月27日在伊哈斯及其周边地区爆发。伊哈斯原是一个村庄，如今属于马尔卡尔特。凯梅蒂·捷尔吉将军率领的匈牙利师与阿道夫·许特·埃德勒·冯·瓦伦斯贝格中将率领的奥地利格斯特纳旅交战。

en.s: The Battle of Mathias Point, Virginia (June 27, 1861) was an early naval action of the American Civil War in connection with the Union blockade and the corresponding effort by the Confederates to deny use of the Potomac to the enemy. Two Union gunboats tried to prevent the Confederates from installing a battery on the Potomac at Mathias Point in King George County, Virginia. A landing party prepared to install their own battery, but were beaten back before they could unload their guns from the USS Thomas Freeborn. Cannon fire from this vessel kept the Confederates temporarily at bay, and Commander James H.

zh.s: 1861年6月27日，美国内战期间，北军与南军在弗吉尼亚州马赛厄斯角附近发生早期海战，围绕北军封锁及南军阻止敌方使用波托马克河展开。两艘北军炮艇试图阻止南军在马赛厄斯角设置炮台。北军登陆队也准备架设自己的炮台，但在尚未从“托马斯·弗里伯恩号”卸下火炮前便被击退；该舰炮火一度压制南军，北军指挥官詹姆斯·H·沃德下令再次登陆，登陆队又遭击退，沃德阵亡，成为战争中首位阵亡的北军海军军官。

en.s: The Battle of Garnett's and Golding's Farms took place June 27–28, 1862, in Henrico County, Virginia, as part of the Seven Days Battles of the American Civil War's Peninsula Campaign. While the battle at Gaines's Mill raged north of the Chickahominy River, the forces of Confederate general John B. Magruder conducted a reconnaissance in force that developed into a minor attack against the Union line south of the river at Garnett's Farm.

zh.t: 加内特农场和戈尔丁农场战役
zh.s: 加内特农场和戈尔丁农场战役于1862年6月27日至28日在弗吉尼亚州亨里科县爆发，是美国内战七日战役及半岛战役的一部分。盖恩斯磨坊战役在奇克霍米尼河北岸激战时，邦联将军约翰·B·马格鲁德率军在南岸实施武力侦察，后来演变为对联邦军加内特农场阵地的一次小规模进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Portland Harbor was an incident during the American Civil War, in June 1863, in the waters off Portland, Maine. Two civilian ships engaged two vessels under Confederate States Navy employment.

zh.s: 波特兰港战斗是美国内战期间的一次冲突，发生于1863年6月缅因州波特兰附近海域。两艘民用船只与两艘受南方邦联海军指挥的船只交战。

Lee. The Confederate cavalry leader General J.E.B.

en.s: The Battle of Kennesaw Mountain was fought on June 27, 1864, during the Atlanta Campaign of the American Civil War. It was the most significant frontal assault launched by Union Maj. Gen. William T. Sherman against the Confederate Army of Tennessee under Gen. Joseph E. Johnston, ending in a tactical defeat for the Union forces. Strategically, however, the battle failed to deliver the result that the Confederacy desperately needed—namely a halt to Sherman's advance on Atlanta. Sherman's 1864 campaign against Atlanta, Georgia, was initially characterized by a series of flanking maneuvers against Johnston, each of which compelled the Confederate army to withdraw from heavily fortified positions with minimal casualties on either side.

zh.s: 肯尼索山战役于1864年6月27日在美国内战亚特兰大战役期间爆发。威廉·T·谢尔曼少将率领的联邦军对约瑟夫·E·约翰斯顿将军指挥的田纳西邦联军发动了最重要的一次正面进攻，联邦军在战术上失利。但从战略上看，邦联军仍未能实现急需的目标——阻止谢尔曼向亚特兰大推进。谢尔曼1864年进攻佐治亚州亚特兰大的战役起初以一系列侧翼机动为主，迫使约翰斯顿的军队撤出防守严密的阵地，双方伤亡都较少。

en.s: The Battle of Trautenau (German: Schlacht bei Trautenau) or Battle of Trutnov was fought on June 27, 1866, during the Austro-Prussian War. It was the only battle of the war that ended in an Austrian victory over the Prussians, but at a large cost.

zh.s: 特劳特瑙战役（德语：Schlacht bei Trautenau），又称特鲁特诺夫战役，于1866年6月27日在普奥战争期间爆发。这是战争中唯一一场以奥地利击败普鲁士告终的战役，但奥军也付出了沉重代价。

en.s: The Battle of Náchod (German: Nachod) on 27 June 1866 was the first major action of the Austro-Prussian War. The advance guard of General Karl Friedrich von Steinmetz's 5th Corps occupied some high ground near Náchod as part of a Prussian advance into Bohemia from Silesia. Elements of the Austrian 6th Corps under General Von Ramming came on the scene and attacked the Prussians but were repulsed.

zh.s: 纳霍德战役于1866年6月27日爆发，是普奥战争中的首次重大交战。卡尔·弗里德里希·冯·施泰因梅茨将军率领的普鲁士第五军先头部队占领纳霍德附近的高地，作为从西里西亚向波希米亚推进的一部分。冯·拉明将军率领的奥地利第六军部分部队随后赶到并进攻普军，但被击退。

en.s: The Battle of Podol was a minor engagement in the opening days of the Königgrätz campaign of the Austro-Prussian War in Bohemia on 26 and 27 June 1866. The battle took place in modern-day Svijany between troops of the Prussian First Army (Julius von Bose's 15th Brigade) and elements of Eduard Clam-Gallas' Austrian I Corps.

zh.s: 波多尔战役是普奥战争克尼格雷茨战役初期的一场小规模交战，于1866年6月26日至27日在波希米亚爆发。战场位于如今的斯维扬尼，交战双方是普鲁士第一集团军（尤利乌斯·冯·博泽第15旅）和克拉姆-加拉斯率领的奥地利第一军部分部队。

en.s: The Battle of Langensalza was fought on 27 June 1866, during the Austro-Prussian War, near Bad Langensalza in what is now modern Germany, between the Kingdom of Hanover and the Kingdom of Prussia. The Hanoverians won the battle but were then surrounded by a larger and reinforced Prussian army. Unable to link up with their Bavarian allies to the south, the Hanoverians surrendered.

zh.s: 朗根萨尔察战役于1866年6月27日在普奥战争期间爆发，战场位于如今德国巴特朗根萨尔察附近，交战双方为汉诺威王国和普鲁士王国。汉诺威军获胜，但随后被兵力更多且得到增援的普军包围。由于无法与南方的巴伐利亚盟军会合，汉诺威军最终投降。

en.s: The Boshin War (戊辰戦争, Boshin Sensō), sometimes known as the Japanese Revolution or Japanese Civil War, was a civil war in Japan fought from 1868 to 1869 between forces of the ruling Tokugawa shogunate and a coalition seeking to seize political power in the name of the Imperial Court. The war stemmed from dissatisfaction among many nobles and young samurai with the shogunate's handling of foreigners following the opening of Japan during the prior decade.

en.s: The Second Battle of Adobe Walls was fought on June 27, 1874, between Comanche forces and a group of twenty-eight U.S. bison hunters defending the settlement of Adobe Walls, in what is now Hutchinson County, Texas. "Adobe Walls was scarcely more than a lone island in the vast sea of the Great Plains, a solitary refuge uncharted and practically unknown."

en.s: The Battle of Simnitza took place between the Russians and the Turks fought on 26 June 1877 at Svishtov (Sistova), on the right bank of the Danube in present-day Veliko Tarnovo Province, Bulgaria. The Russians won the battle and occupied Sistova on 27 June. The Russians were led by Field Marshal Grand Duke Nicholas.

en.s: The First Battle of Agordat, the first battle between Italy and Mahdist Sudan, took place on June 27, 1890. Violence began when a force of one-thousand Mahdists raided the Beni Amer, "a tribe under Italian protection." After that, the Sudanese continued on to the wells at Agordat, where they were met by two companies of Italian-led ascari. The battle that ensued was an Italian victory, with 250 Mahdists being killed.

zh.s: 阿戈达特第一次战役于1890年6月27日爆发，是意大利与马赫迪苏丹国之间的首次交战。1,000名马赫迪战士袭击了受意大利保护的贝尼阿梅尔部族，随后前往阿戈达特的水井，在那里遭遇两个由意大利人率领的阿斯卡里连。战斗以意大利获胜告终，250名马赫迪战士被杀。

en.s: The Battle of Passo Fundo or the Battle of the Pulador was a military engagement fought between forces of the First Brazilian Republic and various military units affiliated with the Federalist Revolution. The battle, which was fought on 27 June 1894 along the Passo Fundo River (in the state of Rio Grande do Sul), was the largest battle of the Federalist Revolution.

zh.s: 帕索丰杜战役又称普拉多尔战役，于1894年6月27日在帕索丰杜河沿岸爆发，交战双方是巴西第一共和国军队和联邦革命的各支武装。这是联邦革命期间规模最大的一场战役。

en.s: The 1908 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 21st All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1908 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Tipperary were winners after a replay and extended their 100% record in All Ireland Finals to eight wins out of eight. This record came to an end when Tipperary got to the Final again in 1909 where they lost to Kilkenny.

zh.s: 1908年全爱尔兰高级板棍球锦标赛决赛是该项赛事的第21场全爱尔兰决赛，由爱尔兰各郡顶尖板棍球队参赛。蒂珀雷里队在重赛后获胜，将其全爱尔兰决赛纪录延续至八战全胜。该纪录于1909年被打破：蒂珀雷里队再次打进决赛，但输给了基尔肯尼队。

en.t: The Johor–Singapore Causeway opens after five years of construction, providing a land connection for road and rail vehicles travelling between Johor and Singapore
en.s: The Johor–Singapore Causeway is a 1.056-kilometre (0.66 mi) causeway across the Straits of Johor. The Causeway links Johor Bahru in Malaysia to Woodlands in Singapore. It is one of the busiest border crossings in the world, with 300,000 road and rail travelers daily. The Causeway also serves as a water pipeline between the two countries. The Causeway officially opened in 1923.

zh.s: 柔佛—新加坡长堤横跨柔佛海峡，全长1.056公里（0.66英里）。长堤连接马来西亚新山和新加坡兀兰，是全球最繁忙的陆路口岸之一，每天有30万名道路和铁路旅客经过。长堤也为两国输送自来水。该长堤于1923年正式通车。

en.s: From March 12 to June 27, 1940, voters of the Democratic Party elected delegates to the 1940 Democratic National Convention through a series of primaries, caucuses, and conventions. Incumbent President Franklin D. Roosevelt was selected as the party's presidential nominee despite not formally declaring a campaign for a third term. Supporters effectively drafted Roosevelt, who was non-committal about seeking re-election, amid rising concerns over war in Europe.

en.s: The June Uprising (Lithuanian: Birželio sukilimas) was a brief period in late June 1941 between the first Soviet and the Nazi occupations. A year earlier, on June 15, 1940, the Red Army occupied Lithuania and established the unpopular Lithuanian Soviet Socialist Republic, which silenced its critics and suppressed resistance with political repression and state terrorism.

The battle was fought between the elements of the German 4th Panzer Group and the Soviet 3rd Mechanized Corps with the 12th Mechanised Corps, in Lithuania, 75 km (47 mi) north-west of Kaunas.

en.s: The Parliament of Canada (French: Parlement du Canada) is the federal legislature of Canada. The Crown, along with two chambers (the Senate and the House of Commons), form the bicameral legislature. The 343 members of the lower house, the House of Commons, are styled as members of Parliament (MPs), and each elected to represent an electoral district (also known as a riding).
en.n: In the Canadian Citizenship Act, the Parliament of Canada establishes the definition of Canadian citizenship.

zh.t: 加拿大议会规定加拿大公民身份
zh.s: 加拿大议会（法语：Parlement du Canada）是加拿大联邦立法机关。君主和参议院、众议院共同组成两院制议会。下议院共有343名议员，称为国会议员（MP），每人代表一个选区。
zh.n: 《加拿大公民法》由加拿大议会制定，规定了加拿大公民身份的定义。

en.s: The 1949 Canadian federal election was held June 27, 1949, to elect members of the House of Commons of Canada of the 21st Parliament of Canada. The Liberal Party of Canada was re-elected with its fourth consecutive government, winning 191 seats (73 per cent of the seats in the House of Commons), with just under 50 per cent of the popular vote.

en.s: The Battle of Suwon Airfield was the first aerial battle of the Korean War occurring on June 27, 1950 over Kimpo Airfield and Suwon Airfield. The battle, between aircraft of the United States and North Korea, ended in a victory for the US Air Force after nine of its aircraft successfully shot down seven North Korean People's Air Force aircraft. It was the first direct engagement of the Air Battle of South Korea. With the outbreak of the war two days earlier, the US forces were attempting to evacuate US civilians and diplomats from the city of Seoul, where a battle was ongoing between North and South Korean forces.

zh.s: 水原机场空战是朝鲜战争中的首次空战，于1950年6月27日在金浦机场和水原机场上空爆发。美军9架飞机击落朝鲜人民军空军7架飞机，取得胜利。这也是韩国上空首次直接空战。战争爆发两天后，美军正试图从首尔撤离美国平民和外交官；当时首尔正在发生南北韩军队之间的战斗。

en.t: Battle of Berne (1954 FIFA World Cup)
en.s: The Battle of Berne (Hungarian: Berni csata, Portuguese: Batalha de Berna, German: Schlacht bei Bern, French: Bataille de Berne, Italian: Battaglia di Berna, Romansh: Battaglia da Berna) was a football match at the 1954 World Cup between Hungary and Brazil, a quarter-final played on 27 June 1954 at the Wankdorf Stadium in Bern, Switzerland. Violent conduct and fighting prompted English referee Arthur Ellis to send off three players during the match. Fighting between the teams continued in the dressing rooms after the final whistle.

zh.s: 伯尔尼之战（匈牙利语：Berni csata，葡萄牙语：Batalha de Berna，德语：Schlacht bei Bern，法语：Bataille de Berne，意大利语：Battaglia di Berna，罗曼什语：Battaglia da Berna）是1954年6月27日世界杯匈牙利对巴西的四分之一决赛，在瑞士伯尔尼万克多夫球场举行。比赛中双方球员动作粗野并发生斗殴，英格兰裁判亚瑟·埃利斯罚下三人。终场哨响后，两队球员又在更衣室里打了起来。

en.s: A by-election for one of the French National Assembly seats from Guinea was held on June 27, 1954. The socialist Yaciné Diallo, who had won one of the three Guinean seats in the 1951 French National Assembly election, died in April 1954, after which the by-election was called. The election was won by Diawadou Barry, but it also marked of the ascent of Sékou Touré's Democratic Party of Guinea (PDG) in Guinean politics.

zh.s: 1954年6月27日，法兰西国民议会的几内亚席位举行补选。社会党人亚西内·迪亚洛曾在1951年法国国民议会选举中赢得三个几内亚席位之一，并于1954年4月去世，随后触发补选。迪亚瓦杜·巴里当选；这次选举也标志着塞古·杜尔领导的几内亚民主党开始在几内亚政坛崛起。

en.s: The 1954 North Rhine-Westphalia state election was held on 27 June 1954 to elect the 3rd Landtag of North Rhine-Westphalia. The outgoing government was a coalition of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) and Centre Party led by Minister-President Karl Arnold. The CDU remained the largest party and improved its result to 41.3%, a swing of 4.4 percentage points. The Social Democratic Party (SPD) also improved slightly and finished on 34.5%.

en.s: The democratically elected Guatemalan president Jacobo Árbenz was deposed in a coup d'état in 1954, marking the end of the Guatemalan Revolution. The coup installed the military dictatorship of Carlos Castillo Armas, the first in a series of U.S.-backed authoritarian rulers in Guatemala. The coup was precipitated by a CIA covert operation code-named PBSuccess. The Guatemalan Revolution began in 1944, after a popular uprising toppled the military dictatorship of Jorge Ubico.

en.s: Hurricane Audrey was a catastrophic and very deadly hurricane that devastated the southwestern Louisiana coast in 1957. Along with Hurricane Alex in 2010, it was also the most intense June hurricane ever recorded in the Atlantic basin, with a pressure of 946 mbar (hPa; 27.91 inHg), and was the strongest in terms of windspeed until Hurricane Beryl in 2024.
en.n: Hurricane Audrey makes landfall near the Texas–Louisiana border, killing over 400 people, mainly in and around Cameron, Louisiana.

zh.t: 奥黛丽飓风在得克萨斯州与路易斯安那州交界附近登陆，造成400多人死亡
zh.s: 奥黛丽飓风于1957年重创路易斯安那州西南海岸，是一场灾难性的强烈飓风。与2010年的亚历克斯飓风并列，它是大西洋盆地有记录以来6月最强的飓风之一，中心气压达946毫巴（百帕；27.91英寸汞柱）。在2024年贝丽尔飓风之前，它也是有记录以来风速最强的6月飓风。

en.s: Voters in the Bachok constituency of Kelantan, Malaysia, went to the polls on June 27, 1964, after the death of sitting parliament member Zulkiflee Muhammad. Abu Bakar Hamzah of the Pan-Malaysian Islamic Party retained the seat, defeating the Alliance candidate Abdul Ghani Fikri Sulaiman by 11,900 votes to 8,661.

en.s: The 1973 Uruguayan coup d'état took place in Uruguay on 27 June 1973 and marked the beginning of the civic-military dictatorship which lasted until 1985. President Juan María Bordaberry closed parliament, and ruled with the assistance of a junta of military generals. The official reason was to crush the Tupamaros, a Marxist urban guerrilla movement. The leftist trade union federations called a general strike and occupation of factories. The strike lasted just over two weeks. It was ended with most of the trade union leaders in jail, dead, or exiled to Argentina.

zh.s: 1973年6月27日，乌拉圭发生政变，开启了持续到1985年的文官与军方联合独裁统治。总统胡安·玛丽亚·博达贝里解散议会，并在军方将领组成的委员会协助下执政。官方给出的理由是镇压马克思主义城市游击组织图帕马罗斯。左翼工会联合会随后号召总罢工并占领工厂。罢工持续两个多星期，结束时大多数工会领袖已入狱、遇害或流亡阿根廷。

en.s: The Manchester Exchange by-election of 27 June 1973 was held after the death of William Griffiths on 14 April of the same year. en.s: A presidential election was held in Portugal on 27 June 1976. With a broad base of support that comprised the center-left and the center-right, Ramalho Eanes won the election on the first round with more than 61% of the votes and became the first elected President of Portugal after the Carnation Revolution. The Portuguese Communist Party presented its own candidate, Octávio Pato, a well known anti-fascist, but performed poorly, receiving just under 8% of the votes.

en.s: The Entebbe raid, also known as Operation Entebbe and officially codenamed Operation Thunderbolt (subsequently Operation Yonatan), was a 3 July 1976 Israeli counter-terrorist mission in Uganda. It was launched in response to the hijacking of an Air France flight from Tel Aviv to Paris by members of the PFLP-EO and the German Revolutionary Cells, who diverted the aircraft to Entebbe International Airport with the backing of Ugandan dictator Idi Amin.

en.s: STS-4 was the fourth NASA Space Shuttle mission, and also the fourth for Space Shuttle Columbia. Crewed by Ken Mattingly and Henry Hartsfield, the mission launched on June 27, 1982, and landed a week later on July 4, 1982. Due to parachute malfunctions, the SRBs were not recovered. STS-4 was the final test flight for the Space Shuttle; it was thereafter officially declared to be operational.

en.s: The Villa Tunari Massacre was a 27 June 1988 mass murder committed by UMOPAR (Rural Patrol Mobile Unit) troops in response to a protest by coca-growing peasants (cocaleros) in the town of Villa Tunari in Chapare Province, Bolivia. The cocalero movement had mobilized since late May 1988 in opposition to coca eradication under Law 1008, then on the verge of becoming law. According to video evidence and a joint church-labor investigative commission, UMOPAR opened fire on unarmed protesters, at least two of whom were fatally shot, and many of whom fled to their deaths over a steep drop into the San Mateo River.

en.s: Strikeforce: Melendez vs. Thomson was a mixed martial arts event promoted by Strikeforce. The event took place at the HP Pavilion at San Jose in San Jose, California on Friday, June 27, 2008. en.t: Zimbabwe holds a presidential runoff after Tsvangirai withdraws
en.s: On June 27, 2008, Zimbabwe held the second round of its presidential election. Morgan Tsvangirai had withdrawn after violence against his supporters, leaving Robert Mugabe as the only candidate actively contesting the poll.

zh.t: 茨万吉拉伊退选后，津巴布韦仍举行总统选举第二轮投票
zh.s: 2008年6月27日，津巴布韦举行总统选举第二轮投票。摩根·茨万吉拉伊因支持者遭受暴力袭击而退出竞选，罗伯特·穆加贝成为唯一仍在参选的候选人。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Guinea in 2010. It was held under the two-round system: the first round took place on 27 June 2010, and the second round on 7 November, after an initial date of 18 July and many other postponements. Alpha Condé was declared the winner, with 52.52% of the votes in the second round. He assumed office on 21 December 2010. The election came after a coup in 2008 and the attempted assassination of the junta leader Moussa Dadis Camara in December 2009.

zh.s: 几内亚于2010年举行总统选举，采用两轮制。首轮于2010年6月27日举行；第二轮原定于7月18日，经过多次延期后于11月7日举行。阿尔法·孔戴在第二轮获得52.52%的选票并当选，于2010年12月21日就职。此次选举是在2008年政变，以及军政府领导人穆萨·达迪斯·卡马拉于2009年12月遭遇暗杀未遂后举行的。

The match was played between Zimbru Chișinău, winners of the 2013–14 Moldovan Cup, and Sheriff Tiraspol, champions of the 2013–14 National Division. en.s: On 27 June 2015, a dust fire occurred at Formosa Fun Coast, a water park in Bali, New Taipei City, Taiwan. Staff of an outdoor "color powder party" sprayed participants with clouds of corn starch, which ignited. The fire lasted 40 seconds and burned 508 people, killing 15 and leaving 199 in critical condition. Initially, only patches of airborne corn starch caught fire and were extinguished almost instantly, but due to the spraying of carbon-dioxide fire extinguishers by staff towards the participants, along with the running of the participants, the airborne corn starch dispersed into multiple dust clouds which was responsible for most of the burning.

zh.t: 2015年新北市八仙乐园粉尘爆燃事故
zh.s: 2015年6月27日，台湾新北市八里区的八仙乐园发生粉尘爆燃。户外“彩色派对”工作人员向参加者喷洒玉米淀粉粉末，粉末随后燃烧。火势持续40秒，造成508人烧伤，其中15人死亡、199人重伤，情况危急。起初只有少量空气中的玉米淀粉着火，很快被扑灭；但工作人员向人群喷射二氧化碳灭火器，参加者也四散奔跑，使粉末扩散成多个粉尘云，造成大部分烧伤。

en.s: A series of powerful cyberattacks using the Petya malware began on 27 June 2017 that swamped websites of Ukrainian organizations, including banks, ministries, newspapers, and electricity firms. Similar infections were reported in France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Russia, United Kingdom, the United States, and Australia. ESET estimated on 28 June 2017 that 80% of all infections were in Ukraine, with Germany second hardest hit with about 9%.

zh.s: 2017年6月27日，Petya恶意软件引发一系列大规模网络攻击，乌克兰多家机构的网站瘫痪，包括银行、政府部门、报社和电力公司。法国、德国、意大利、波兰、俄罗斯、英国、美国和澳大利亚也报告了类似感染。ESET于2017年6月28日估计，所有感染中80%发生在乌克兰；德国受影响第二严重，约占9%。
